# Kdrama Fighting

> > A fan-driven Korean drama blog featuring reviews, character analysis, fashion commentary, and community discussions about popular kdramas like Coffee Prince, You're Beautiful, and Heirs.

Kdrama Fighting is run by bloggers Vivi and CoCo, who provide entertaining and honest takes on Korean dramas with a focus on romance, strong female leads, and the emotional rollercoaster of kdrama watching. The site blends critical reviews with lighthearted features like fashion face-offs and personality quizzes.

## Key Topics

- Kdrama reviews and recommendations
- Romance and romantic comedy
- Strong female leads and character analysis
- Fashion face-offs and kdrama style
- Popular dramas: Coffee Prince, You're Beautiful, Heirs
- DramaFever and streaming platforms
- Second-lead syndrome
- Korean actors and celebrity comparisons
- First impressions and new drama alerts
- Kdrama community and fan discussions
- OST and music awards
- Medical dramas and genre diversity
- Live blogging and episode recaps
- Asian-American representation
- Kdrama vs. Hollywood comparisons

## Essential Kdrama Reviews & Recommendations

- [To All the Dramas I've Loved Before: Top 10 Favorite K-dramas of All Time](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2018/11/-top-10-best-kdramas.html): Vivi and Coco's all-time favorite kdramas including Coffee Prince
- [The 10 Best Smart, Strong Korean Drama Female Leads](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2013/07/10-best-smart-strong-korean-drama.html): Top 10 list of strong female characters from Queen In Hyun's Man and more
- [Korean Drama is the New Twilight: Intro to CoCo](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2013/02/korean-drama-is-new-twilight.html): CoCo's intro post comparing kdrama discovery to Twilight via Lie To Me
- [Live Blogging the Heirs Finale](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2013/12/live-blogging-heirs-finale.html): Live recap and reactions to Heirs finale with Kim Woo Bin's Young Do
- [I Demand a Recount (part 2): You Are Beautiful Review](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2013/02/i-demand-recount-part-2-you-are.html): Critical review and unpopular opinion on You're Beautiful characters

## Drama Reviews & First Impressions

- [New K-drama Alert: The Liar and His Lover (aka Lovely Love Lie) Review](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2017/03/new-k-drama-alert-liar-and-his-lover.html): Critical review of musical drama starring Lee Hyun Woo and Red Velvet's Joy
- [New Dramas: King of High School, Joseon Gunman, and Trot Lovers](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2014/07/new-dramas-king-of-high-school-joseon.html): First impressions of three new dramas including Seo In Guk's Trot Lovers
- [Summertime Funnertime: Dating Agency: Cyrano Review](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2013/08/summertime-funnertime-dating-agency.html): Review of tvN's romantic comedy from the Oh!Boy Flower Boy series
- [Emergency Couple Korean Drama Review](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2014/04/emergency-couple-korean-drama-review.html): Medical drama review with Song Ji Hyo and second-lead syndrome discussion
- [New K-drama Alert: My Secret Romance Review](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2017/04/new-k-drama-alert-my-secret-romance.html): First impressions of OCN romcom with Sung Hoon and Song Ji Eun
- [A Collage of Better Shows: Nail Shop Paris Korean Drama Review](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2013/10/a-collage-of-better-shows-nail-shop.html): Review of supernatural romance Nail Shop Paris with gumiho and love triangle

## Kdrama Community & Culture

- [7 times K-dramas make us act like overly emotional children](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2014/06/7-times-k-dramas-make-us-act-like.html): Humorous listicle about intense emotional reactions to kdrama watching
- [Told You Kdramas Were The New Twilight!: Interview With Justin Chon](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2013/11/told-you-kdramas-were-new-twilight.html): Justin Chon interview discussing kdramas and Asian-American representation
- [K-drama Music Awards: Let Your Voices Be Heard!](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2013/02/k-drama-music-awards-let-your-voices-be_16.html): Fan voting poll for best kdrama OST and soundtrack awards
- [Quiz: Which Sungkyunkwan Scholar Is Your Ideal Match?](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2013/07/quiz-which-sungkyunkwan-scholar-is-your.html): Interactive personality quiz for Sungkyunkwan Scandal character matching
- [(Not Really) Fashion Face-Off Friday: Kdrama Proposals](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2013/09/not-really-fashion-face-off-friday.html): Best kdrama wedding proposals featuring Hyun Bin and Cha Seung Won

## Fashion Face-Offs & Celebrity Comparisons

- [Fashion Face-Off Friday: Kdrama Battle of the Guyliner](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2013/05/fashion-face-off-friday-kdrama-battle.html): Male makeup comparison from Protect the Boss and Flower Boy Band
- [Fashion Face-off Friday: Seasonal Fashion](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2013/10/fashion-face-off-friday-seasonal-fashion.html): Seasonal fashion comparison from History of a Salaryman and Nail Shop Paris
- [More Kdrama Hollywood Lookalikes](https://www.kdramafighting.com/2013/06/more-kdrama-hollywood-lookalikes.html): Comparing Korean actors like Lee Yoon-ji and Sung Joon to Hollywood stars
